adds.title: Peter's To-Do List
adds.text: Before their class trip to Europe, Peter tells Ned about the errands he has to run, from picking up his passport to taking down the Manfredi crime family.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tells Ned his to-do list before Europe, crime family included.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hears Peter's to-do list before the class trip to Europe.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'On the eve of his departure to Europe, Peter Parker tells Ned Leeds that he has several things to do before they leave', including taking down the Manfredi Crime Family.

adds.title: Peter's To-Do List
adds.text: On the last day of school, Flash throws a wad of paper at Peter as he walks past his locker.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate Flash pelts with a wad of paper on the last day of school.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Classmate who throws a wad of paper at Peter on the last day of school.
adds.evidence: Flash Thompson page (ref PTDL): 'On their last day of school, Thompson threw a wad of paper at Peter Parker as he and Ned Leeds walked past his locker.' Flash is in the short's cast.

adds.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
adds.text: After graduating from MIT, MJ and Ned move back to New York and share an apartment, where they invite a masked Spider-Man over and bond with him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Shares an apartment with MJ back in New York after MIT.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Shares an apartment with Ned back in New York after MIT.
adds.evidence: Plot: 'Ned and MJ move back to New York after graduating from MIT'; MJ 'invites him to her and Ned's apartment, where a masked Parker bonds with them both.'

adds.title: The Wolverine
adds.text: Two years after Japan, Xavier, long believed dead, reveals himself to Logan at an airport and backs Magneto's warning about a weapon that could end the mutant race.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Believed dead, returns to warn Logan of a threat to all mutants.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Xavier comes back to warn of a threat to all mutants.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: Logan, back in the US two years later, is approached at the airport by Erik, who warns of a weapon that would end the mutant race; Logan refuses to believe him until Charles Xavier, presumed dead, reveals himself working alongside Erik.

adds.title: The Wolverine
adds.text: Magneto approaches Logan at an airport and warns him that humans are building a weapon that would end the mutant race. Logan does not believe him until Xavier appears at Magneto's side.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Warns Logan of a weapon built to end the mutant race.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man Magneto warns of a weapon built to end the mutant race.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: Erik Lehnsherr approaches Logan at the airport and warns him of a weapon humans are creating that would end the mutant race; Logan refuses to believe him until Xavier reveals he is working with Erik.

adds.title: The Wolverine
adds.text: Charles, long believed dead, is working alongside Erik again, and the two come to Logan together to warn him of a threat to all mutants.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Charles's old rival, working beside him again.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Believed dead, now working beside Erik again.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: Xavier, presumed dead after The Last Stand, reveals himself to be working alongside Lehnsherr as Erik warns Logan at the airport.

adds.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
adds.text: Ben throws Reed a bachelor party before his wedding to Sue and gets him onto the dance floor, then fights beside him against the Surfer and Doom.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Throws Reed a bachelor party before the wedding.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Ben's best friend, whose bachelor party he throws.
adds.evidence: Early in the film Reed attends a bachelor party (Sue: 'I'm glad you had fun... nothing compared to what I did at my bachelorette party'); Ben hosts it and pushes Reed to dance. The team then fights the Surfer and Doom together (Ben knocks Doom off the board).

adds.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
adds.text: After the Surfer leaves Johnny able to swap powers by touch, Ben trades powers with him for a moment. Later, when Johnny takes the whole team's powers to fight Doom, Ben knocks Doom off the board with a crane.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Swaps powers with Ben for a moment, then takes on Doom with his help.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Swaps powers with Johnny, then knocks Doom off the board for him.
adds.evidence: Ben 'enjoyed the opportunity to briefly swap powers with Johnny to demonstrate Johnny's odd condition'; when Johnny borrows the team's powers to oppose Victor, 'Ben uses a demolition crane to knock Doom off the Surfer's board'.

adds.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
adds.text: In London, Sue holds the falling London Eye level with a force field so Ben can lift it back into place and save its riders.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Lifts the London Eye back into place while Sue holds it level.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Holds the London Eye level so Ben can lift it back.
adds.evidence: The team saves the London Eye and its passengers in London; Sue's force fields 'level a large building structure so Ben could lift it back into place', and Ben lifts 'a large building structure (about 1,000 tons) with Sue leveling it'.

adds.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
adds.text: Wong calls Bruce and Carol in to Kamar-Taj to study the Ten Rings with Shang-Chi and Katy, and they find the rings are sending out a beacon.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Bruce in to study the Ten Rings at Kamar-Taj.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Wong calls in to study the Ten Rings.
adds.evidence: Mid-credits scene: 'Wong introduces Shang-Chi and Katy to Bruce Banner and Carol Danvers and the group discusses the origins of the rings. They discover that the rings are acting as a beacon.'

adds.title: Runaways S1–S2#16
adds.text: Breaking into the Church of Gibborim, Molly rips open the box holding Geoffrey and carries him back to the Hostel.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Alex's father. Molly frees him from a box at the church and carries him out.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The girl who frees Geoffrey from a box and carries him to safety.
adds.evidence: S2E6 (running #16): at the Church of Gibborim the Runaways find two Dematerialization Boxes; 'Hernandez ripped open the other to find Geoffrey Wilder. Hernandez used her strength to carry him out of the room and back to the Hostel.' (ref RW206)

adds.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
adds.text: When Frances takes Anne, Dan calls Eddie to tell him where she is, then helps him at Grace Cathedral by setting Carnage on fire.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Eddie when Anne is taken, then sets Carnage on fire.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Anne's ex, whom Dan calls when Frances takes her.
adds.evidence: Eddie advises Dan and Anne to leave San Francisco; after Shriek abducts Anne, Dan 'called Brock and told him that Shriek and Kasady captured Weying and took her to Grace Cathedral', then 'doused Carnage with burning gasoline'.

adds.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
adds.text: Mrs. Chen keeps Eddie supplied with chocolate in exchange for Venom guarding her store. When Anne comes looking for Venom, she scolds her for breaking Eddie's heart.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Trades chocolate for Venom guarding her store.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend whose Venom guards Mrs. Chen's store.
adds.evidence: Mrs. Chen 'made a deal with Eddie, so he would protect her as Venom in exchange for chocolate supplies' (ref Let There Be Carnage); she 'angrily accuse[s] [Anne] of breaking Eddie Brock's heart'.

owner_calls.title: Venom
owner_calls.question: Kasady's prison interview is with Eddie while Venom is bonded inside him but silent. Does Venom being present through Eddie count as dealing with Kasady here, for a stage in Venom?
options: Add an enemy stage in Venom: Kasady promises carnage to Eddie and Venom
owner_calls.evidence: Eddie later interviews Cletus Kasady, who promises 'carnage' when he escapes; the symbiote is secretly bonded to Eddie.

owner_calls.title: Peter's To-Do List
owner_calls.question: Flash throws a wad of paper at Peter as Peter and Ned walk past his locker. Is sharing that moment enough for a Ned|Flash stage here?
options: Add a rival stage: Flash jeers at Peter and Ned as they pass his locker
owner_calls.evidence: 'Thompson threw a wad of paper at Peter Parker as he and Ned Leeds walked past his locker.'
